Aisha (partnerships): Heads-up — NebulaEdge Azure Marketplace PO 3421789 is stuck; EDI ack failing due to billing address mismatch between customer profile and vendor portal. Customer is pushing a launch tomorrow, flagged as urgent.
procurement-bot: PO 3421789 status: REJECTED — reason=billing_address_mismatch. Logs: EDI_ACK_ERROR: 400_BAD_REQUEST.
Liam (finance): What's the delta? Can we accept manual invoice or force payment to unblock?
Tom (legal): NebulaEdge submitted a redline removing our mutual indemnity. We can't accept that as-is. If the finance team wants to proceed, we need an exec exception AND a written mitigation plan.
Nate (sales): Customer says they'll accept a short payment-term tweak (Net30 -> Net15) if we can get the PO through today. Deal size ~42k ARR — high priority from their side.
Hannah (ops): Marketplace portal enforces vendor entity (DUNS) vs billing contact = mismatch. I can upload an alternate billing contact to the partner portal and manually reconcile if NebulaEdge provides a signed SOW + correct DUNS today.
Aisha (partnerships): Vendor says they'll send DUNS + signed SOW within the hour. Tom, can legal do a fast-track review for one-off indemnity carveout?
Tom (legal): Fast-track possible but need: 1) redline doc, 2) business justification email from sales, 3) GC approval. I can prep the exception request now — send the redline to me.
Liam (finance): Finance can release up to $50k on a temporary credit hold with written approval from head of revenue. If we get legal signoff, we can clear the hold.
Nate (sales): I'll put the justification in an email and ping revenue head. Confirming customer is ok with Net15 + SOW today.
Aisha (partnerships): Plan: Hannah will update the partner portal with vendor DUNS; procurement-bot to resend PO after portal update; Tom to submit exception to GC. @procurement-bot please rerun acceptance once vendor updates are in.
procurement-bot: Actioned — resend scheduled. PO 3421789 resent to vendor at 1712350200. Monitoring for new EDI ack; will post update in thread.
Aisha (partnerships): Great — thanks. I'll coordinate with NebulaEdge and the customer off-thread but will post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
